# Mods for V.A.T.S. - Optimization on rifles and pistols

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_38_nukaknights-post-modsvatsoptimization.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Here at Nuka Knights we regularly discuss the optimal mods for rifles and pistols. Now I would like to get to the point and summarize it.

Many rifles and pistols can be used with these mods for optimal AP consumption, i.e. maximum VATS usage time. If the same mods are not available, the same principle always applies:

*Choose the mod that best optimizes the "Hip Precision"**.*

This works for example also with laser rifles. It's best to choose the mod with the description "Superior precision from the hip".

V.A.T.S. is not aiming in the true sense. The perk “+10% damage when you aim” does not apply to the VATS. VATS shoots from the hip.

For most mods it doesn't matter whether it's automatic or single shot, it depends on the weapon and your personal preferences. However, the automatic mod itself also drastically reduces AP consumption.

## OPTIMAL MODS:

**Run:** Adjusted extended run (5% AP cost reduction)

**Piston / Handle:** Adjusted or balanced piston / handle (5% AP cost reduction)

**Magazine:** Rapid or Fast Magazine (5% AP cost reduction)

**Sight:** Reflex Sight (15% AP cost reduction)

With all these mods you save 30% of your AP and can therefore shoot 30% longer in VATS.

**Shutter:** Automatic shutter (50% AP cost reduction)

**On an automatic weapon with 25% less VATS AP cost consumption, you actually save around 83% AP.**

.50 * 1.25 * 1.05 * 1.05 * 1.05 * 1.15 = 0.83204296875

(See link below fd76 Zerovats)

If you haven't unlocked these mods yet, get the blueprint for the weapon you want, craft it at the lowest level and scrap it to learn the mods.

In the example screenshots you can see a cleaner with the optimal mods.
